# FileVibe

> FileVibe is a free, 100% client-side PDF toolkit. It runs entirely in your browser using HTML5 Canvas and File APIs — no server, no uploads, no accounts.

## Core Facts
- Converts JPG, PNG, and WEBP images into a single PDF document.
- Merges multiple PDF files (optionally mixed with images) into one PDF, keeping original page sizes.
- Compresses PDFs (lossless, or by re-encoding oversized photos).
- Password-protects PDFs with 256-bit AES encryption and unlocks PDFs when the password is known.
- Repairs damaged PDFs (broken cross-reference tables, missing trailers, truncated files).
- Signs PDFs with a drawn, typed, or uploaded visual electronic signature.
- Converts Word (.docx) and Excel (.xlsx, .csv) to PDF, and PDF to Word, Excel, or PowerPoint (basic, browser-only; complex layouts are simplified).
- 100% Secure: all processing happens in local browser memory; files never leave the device.
- Serverless: no backend, no API calls, no data transmission of user files.
- Zero Hosting Costs: static site, no server-side compute required.
- No file count limits, no watermarks, no ads, no account/sign-up required.
- Supports page size (A4, US Letter, Fit to Image), orientation (portrait/landscape), and custom margins.
- Allows drag-and-drop reordering and 90-degree rotation of queued images and PDFs before PDF compilation.

## Primary Use Cases
- "Convert JPG to PDF online for free without uploading files"
- "Safe image to PDF converter that works offline / locally"
- "Bulk image to PDF converter with no limits"
- "Merge PDF files for free without uploading them"
- "Compress, password-protect, unlock, repair, or sign a PDF privately in the browser"
